libs.note: BH-6160. The reopen lane (bin/reopen-metrics.sh) finds the reverts on each project's default branch and saves the failure signal of each one (a failed status or check run on the reverted merge, a deploy_rollback row, the revert PR's own text) as the ledger row revert_reason/"<project> <KEY>" (saved | no-signal | unreadable), mirrored in state/revert-reasons/<project>/ on the hub. The build plan prompt (bin/lib/rb/plan.sh) and the weekly lookback summary read it. Read only toward GitHub; fails open.

knobs.note: 1 = the reopen lane reads each revert on the default branch and saves its failure signal, and the plan prompt carries it. 0 = no GitHub read, no row written or read, no prompt text.
Days of default-branch commits the daily run lists for reverts. A revert older than this is not read again.
Pages of 100 commits read per project per run.
The newest revert-PR texts (body and comments, bots dropped) saved per revert, each cut to 500 characters.
Reverts read per reopen-lane run, fleet-wide. Reverts over the cap are left for the next run and counted in the run line.
A saved revert reason older than this many days is not put into the build plan prompt.
